import 'package:state_kit/state_kit.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/screen_layout.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/data/models/app_settings.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_bloc.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_state.dart';
import 'package:kit_ui/kit_ui.dart';

/// Step 2: how often to check in.
class ModePage extends StatelessWidget {
  const ModePage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = KitColors.of(context);
    final bloc = context.read<OnboardingBloc>();
    return BlocSignalBuilder<OnboardingBloc, OnboardingState>(
      builder: (context, state) => Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: KitSpace.l),
            child: KitTopBar(
              onBack: () => bloc.add(const BackPressed()),
              center: const KitProgressDots(step: 2, count: 4),
              trailingLabel: 'Skip',
              onTrailing: () => bloc.add(const SkipPressed()),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: PinnedBottomColumn(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                KitSpace.l,
                6,
                KitSpace.l,
                KitSpace.xl,
              ),
              bottom: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Not sure? Pick Medium. You can change it per item '
                    'later.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: KitType.captionLarge.copyWith(color: c.ink2),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: KitSpace.s),
                  KitButton(
                    label: 'Continue',
                    onPressed: () => bloc.add(const ContinuePressed()),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              children: [
                Semantics(
                  header: true,
                  child: KitBalancedText(
                    'How often do you check in?',
                    style: KitType.title.copyWith(color: c.ink),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Text(
                  'Think of a usual week.',
                  style: KitType.secondary.copyWith(color: c.ink2),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 18),
                Center(
                  child: SizedBox(
                    width: 180,
                    height: 112,
                    child: KitModeArt(level: state.mode.index),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 18),
                for (final option in _options) ...[
                  KitOptionCard(
                    icon: option.icon,
                    title: option.title,
                    description: option.description,
                    tone: option.tone,
                    selected: state.mode == option.mode,
                    onTap: () => bloc.add(ModeSelected(option.mode)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: KitSpace.gridGap),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Option {
  const _Option(this.mode, this.icon, this.title, this.description, this.tone);

  final HomeMode mode;
  final KitIconData icon;
  final String title;
  final String description;
  final KitOptionTone tone;
}

const List<_Option> _options = [
  _Option(
    HomeMode.vivid,
    KitIcons.sun,
    'Vivid',
    'Every day',
    KitOptionTone.peach,
  ),
  _Option(
    HomeMode.bright,
    KitIcons.clock,
    'Often',
    'Some of the time',
    KitOptionTone.surface,
  ),
  _Option(
    HomeMode.medium,
    KitIcons.home,
    'Medium',
    'Now and then',
    KitOptionTone.dew,
  ),
  _Option(
    HomeMode.low,
    KitIcons.moon,
    'Low',
    'Rarely',
    KitOptionTone.lilac,
  ),
];
